xbrli:xbrl.in-bse-fin:DisclosureOfNotesOnFinancialR:
1. Since there is no provision given for entering "Non financial assets" and "Non financial Liabilities" in the Cash Flow Indirect worksheet , such amount has been adjusted in the line item - Other Adjustment to reconcile Profit(loss)

2.Since there is no provision given for entering "Loans" in the Cash Flow Indirect worksheet , such amount has been adjusted in the line item - Other Adjustment to reconcile Profit(loss)

3. Since there is no provision given for entering Movement in Investments - Mutual Fund & Government Securities, Treasury Bills, Fixed Deposits, hence all such amount has been adjusted / considered in the Other Inflows(outflows) under Cash flow used from Investing Activity

4. Since there is no provision givem for entering Repayment of Debentures , Notes etc such repayment has been considered in Repayment of Borrowings under Cash flow used from Financing Activity


5. Since there is no provision for entering Investment in Associate/ Joint Venture in Assets liabilities worksheet the same has been considered in Investments

6.Since there is no provision for entering Capital work in progress that has been considered in Other Inflows(outflows) under Cash flow used from Investing Activity

7. Since there is no provision for entering loss on sale of fixed assets, it has been considered under other adjustments of non cash items

8. Debt service coverage ratio and interest service coverage ratio are not applicable as the Group is a NBFC.
